scenarios.hypothesis: A sequence of individually permitted delegation edges may produce an effective test capability outside the intended privilege boundary.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A policy simulator reports the synthetic path and final allowed or denied test capability without changing cloud state.
scenarios.positive_control: The documented synthetic delegation path reaches only its intended test capability.
scenarios.negative_control: A neighboring test identity lacking one required edge cannot reach the same simulated capability.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop before any state-changing operation or any account outside the dedicated sandbox.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: The unsafe simulated path is broken while the documented synthetic delegation path remains valid.

scenarios.hypothesis: Identity, resource, boundary, condition, and deny layers may combine differently from the reviewed intended policy.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A controlled policy simulator returns the effective decision and contributing synthetic policy layers.
scenarios.positive_control: An intended synthetic resource/action tuple is allowed under the complete policy set.
scenarios.negative_control: A nearby synthetic tuple that violates one required condition is denied.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop if a result cannot be established through read-only inventory or policy simulation.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: The corrected policy set denies the unintended tuple and preserves the intended simulated access.

scenarios.hypothesis: A workload identity binding may accept a broader synthetic workload selector than the owner intended.
scenarios.safe_oracle: A simulated identity exchange records the controlled workload attributes and resulting test principal.
scenarios.positive_control: The intended synthetic workload attributes map to the expected test principal.
scenarios.negative_control: A neighboring synthetic workload with one mismatched bound attribute is rejected.
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop before using production workload identities or non-sandbox resources.
scenarios.remediation_oracle: The binding requires the complete intended workload identity tuple while the approved synthetic workload still succeeds.
